name: Invoicepress
author: Fahad Mahmood

sections.description:
Author: Fahad Mahmood
Plugin Site: https://www.invoicepress.com

Invoicepress is a simple yet powerful invoicing solution for WordPress. Place the [INVOICEPRESS-FORM] shortcode on any page and your visitors can fill in their details, preview the invoice and download it as a PDF in seconds. Logged-in users can save their invoices and find them again later.

Highlights

  • Works standalone – WooCommerce is optional
  • [INVOICEPRESS-FORM] shortcode for public invoice generation (PDF + printable preview)
  • Multiple line items with quantity, rate, discount and tax rate – totals update live
  • Automatic invoice numbering (prefix, next number, padding)
  • Due dates, payment terms, PO numbers and statuses (draft, sent, paid, overdue, void)
  • “My invoices” list for logged-in users: edit, duplicate, mark as paid, delete, download, email to client
  • Search, filter and CSV export in the admin history tab
  • Logo upload (resized in the browser) and accent colour
  • WooCommerce order → invoice autofill and “Download invoice” button in My Account
  • Unsaved drafts are kept in the visitor’s browser only
  • Generated files get unguessable names and are auto-cleaned
  • Translation ready (languages/invoicepress.pot)

Pro add-on (separate package)

  • Sign in with Google and back up / re-open invoices in the user’s own Google Drive (narrow drive.file permission)
  • More invoice templates
  • Custom fields with drag-and-drop ordering and placement on the invoice
  • Drag & drop a PDF or image and let the form be filled in automatically

External services

The following apply only to the Pro add-on and only when you configure them under Settings → API credentials:

  • Google OAuth / Google Drive API (accounts.google.com, www.googleapis.com) – used for “Continue with Google” and optional Drive backups. Data sent: the OAuth authorisation and, when Drive sync is on, the invoice JSON/PDF files. Terms · Privacy
  • Anthropic API (api.anthropic.com) – used for document import. Data sent: the document the user uploads. Documents are processed in memory and not stored by the plugin. Terms · Privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/invoicepress/ or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate Invoicepress.
  3. Open Settings → Invoicepress (or WooCommerce → Invoicepress) and set your defaults.
  4. Add [INVOICEPRESS-FORM] to any page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is only needed for the order autofill and the My Account download button.

Can visitors use the form without an account?

Yes. Visitors can preview and download PDFs without logging in. Nothing is stored on the server for them. Saving and “My invoices” need a login.

Where are generated files stored?

In uploads/invoicepress/ (protected with an .htaccess file, unguessable file names). Auto-clean is enabled for new installs (1 day) and can be changed under the Statistics tab.

Does it contact any external service?

The core plugin only fetches a logo if you enter a logo URL, and does so through WordPress’ safe HTTP API. The Pro add-on talks to Google (sign-in, Drive) and – only if you add an API key – to an AI provider to read uploaded documents. See “External services”.

Is my data deleted when I remove the plugin?

Only if you tick “Delete all invoices and settings when the plugin is deleted” in Settings.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: multiple line items, quantity/rate, discount, tax rate, due date, PO number, payment terms
  • New: invoice statuses, automatic numbering, CSV export, search and pagination in history
  • New: “My invoices” front-end list ([INVOICEPRESS-MY-INVOICES]) with edit, duplicate, mark paid, delete and email to client
  • New: Settings tab with defaults and a tidy “API credentials” card (no secrets in code)
  • New: logo upload with in-browser resizing, draft autosave, clearer Save / Preview / PDF buttons
  • New (Pro): hardened Google sign-in, Google Drive sync, 4 extra templates, custom fields with positioning, document import
  • Security: capability checks and ownership checks on every AJAX/admin action; delete handler limited to invoices
  • Security: Google OAuth now uses state + PKCE bound to the browser, encrypted tokens and respects registration policy
  • Security: PDF engine no longer fetches remote URLs (SSRF); images are embedded safely
  • Security: invoices post type is now private; generated files use unguessable names; uploads folder protected
  • Security: rate limiting and honeypot on the public form; prepared/validated inputs throughout
  • Fix: tax decimals were truncated, notes were double-escaped, multiple items broke the layout, front-end PDF headers
  • Fix: front-end scripts (Bootstrap) are only loaded on pages that use the shortcodes
  • Fix: PHP 7.4 compatibility, WooCommerce-less sites no longer hit fatal errors in history
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1

1.0.7

  • Maintenance release

1.0.6

  • Added public shortcode [INVOICEPRESS-FORM] with HTML/PDF preview
  • Integrated WooCommerce order field mapping
  • Dynamic invoice fields with label/placeholder options
